name: prodigy-stage
description: PRODIGY STAGE - Art-Net previz, timeline and scene editor for the Prodigy 12 show

scripts.dev: npm run build -w core && concurrently -n server,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w ui
scripts.test:output: npm run build -w core && npm run test:output -w server
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:fixtures && npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:output && npm run test:audio
scripts.test:pipeline: npm run build -w core && npm run test:pipeline -w server
scripts.test:audio: npm run build -w core && npm run test:audio -w server
scripts.test:fixtures: npm run build -w core && npm run test:fixtures -w server
